tests.label: live a2w SWF:SMCT2 tsid (read via CDA SWF) vs generator history ~1Day Decodes-Rev

datum.text: same CWMS location SMCT2, native datum NGVD-29 for the live tsid (CDA vertical-datum-info); the daily series is the same location

operator.p1Basis: USACE A2W SWF:SMCT2 level Top of Conservation

decision.reason: Every pre-registered criterion passes except S1(a): Access2Water serves only the latest value, so the 20-matched-day tie to the CWMS record cannot be built in one session. The single-point tie is exact (diff 0.00 ft at the same timestamp), the tsid string is the CDA series name, and the binding already carries the CWMS read as its first fallback. Closing it needs either a 20-day A2W/CDA log or a human acceptance of the identity-by-tsid argument.

tests.label: live a2w NWP:DET Elev-Forebay (read via CDA NWP) vs generator history USGS 14180500 62614 dv
same, history re-pulled from USGS dv
candidate correction (rule: version-matched daily sibling of the live tsid): live DET.Elev-Forebay.Inst.0.0.MIXED-REV vs DET.Elev-Forebay.Inst.~1Day.0.MIXED-REV

datum.text: A2W NWP:DET vertical datum NGVD29; USGS 14180500 parameter 62614 is 'above NGVD 1929' (site alt datum NGVD29): same datum, no offset

operator.p1Basis: USACE A2W NWP:DET level Top of Conservation / Top of Multi-Purpose

decision.reason: O3 fails (p95 3.10 ft > 2.0) and S1(a) is unestablished (A2W latest value only). The cause is a day-key convention, not a datum: USGS 62614 daily values are statistic 32400 'Observation at 24:00' (value dated 2026-10-10 = the 23:45 PDT reading 1497.68), while the probe reduces the CWMS series to a UTC-day median. Shifting the history one day gives median 0.08 ft / p95 0.61 ft (diagnostic only, not used to classify, no criterion changed). The CWMS daily siblings (~1Day MIXED-REV, CBT-REV) return no values from the public CDA although the catalog lists them.

decision.reason: The generator's own history (MVDhist-rev) stopped on 2024-07-23 (O4 fails, 8 matched days). The version-sibling pool series datman-rev is current but differs from the live 30-minute pool series by a tight constant -0.55 ft (p95 0.58), failing O2 (0.5 ft) by 0.05 ft; the same offset appears against the reviewed lrgsShef-rev series (diagnostic), so it is a series difference inside the MVS database, not a datum offset that the documented NAVD88->NGVD29 estimate (+0.31 ft) explains. The criterion is not relaxed. The hold-out QA's 30.9 ft figure was the Rend Lk TW (tailwater) series.

decision.reason: All of O1-O4 and P1 pass and the hold-out 'mismatch' is a wrong-lake load (Table Rock Dam headwater, 213 ft off). FIXED is withheld only because P2 needs a documented operator range and the licence exhibits (FERC eLibrary P-2221) were not retrievable; the operating range 700.2-704.5 ft seen in 3 years is plausible but undocumented. Lake Taneycomo is a regulated tailwater lake of Table Rock Dam, so its band is set by Powersite Dam gate operations.
